classification.source_level_rationale: created in the course of the activity it documents: This is a specific session record from the National Council proceedings documenting a debate on a petition regarding political prisoners in Turkey.
classification.resume: This is an audio recording of a debate in the Swiss National Council on 22 June 2001 concerning a petition about political prisoners in Turkey and a hunger strike in Turkish prisons. Peter Hess is listed as the speaker in the debate. The record documents parliamentary discussion rather than the events in Turkey themselves.
